scope: Ionization diagnostic at the current1524K star and the lower-density helium quantum domain, using the source GS98 metal proxy. H/He ionization is checked separately from the metal electron deficit; partial metal ionization remains an approximation. This diagnostic does not validate conductivity accuracy, liquid phase stability or the source free-energy error.
derivative_test: Existing full thermal and composition derivative tests extended to rho8500, crossing the former density limit.
